Users on the web/preview will NOT see tasks (2) and (6) of this phase.

rca_of_issue: Expo Metro bundler picks `*.web.tsx` over `*.tsx` on the web platform. The developer updated only `explore.tsx` with (1) the Zomato-style header-location-pill and (2) the highlighted brandTertiary pin-preview-back pill, but left `explore.web.tsx` untouched. Since the user is testing in the web preview, both features appear missing. Mitigation: copy the matching JSX/Styles from explore.tsx into explore.web.tsx (header row + pin-preview sheet header). No code changes required outside those two files.
